title: Chesapeake Land Cover
description: Chesapeake Land Cover is a machine-learning benchmark dataset covering the Chesapeake Bay watershed, comprising 732 tiles (~6km x 7.5km each) across six states (DE, MD, NY, PA, VA, WV). Each tile provides seven co-registered 1m-resolution GeoTIFFs: NAIP aerial imagery (2011-2014), Chesapeake Conservancy six-class land cover labels, NLCD 2011 labels, Landsat 8 leaf-on/leaf-off composites, and Microsoft Bing building footprint masks. The dataset was created to support research into geographic generalization of land cover mapping models.

providers.name: Caleb Robinson (Microsoft AI for Good Research Lab)

sci_citation: Robinson C, Hou L, Malkin K, Soobitsky R, Czawlytko J, Dilkina B, Jojic N. Large Scale High-Resolution Land Cover Mapping with Multi-Resolution Data. Proceedings of the 2019 Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR 2019).
_review: License is compound: custom no-warranty disclaimer for CC land cover labels (not SPDX), public domain for NAIP/Landsat, ODbL-1.0 for building footprints. Assigned ODbL-1.0 as the most restrictive SPDX-expressible component; a human should verify whether the CC label disclaimer constitutes a more restrictive term.
sci_doi is null: the CVPR 2019 paper citation is given in the README but no DOI is explicitly stated. A DOI may exist for the CVPR paper but was not derivable from the README text alone.

temporal_extent start set to 2011 (NAIP 2011/2012 imagery and NLCD 2011 are the oldest inputs); end set to 2017 (Landsat composites use data through 2017). The README does not give explicit study-period dates as a range.
bbox derived from spatial_index.geojson (EPSG:3857 converted to WGS84); covers DE, MD, NY, PA, VA, WV portions of the Chesapeake Bay watershed.

license: Compound license: NAIP and Landsat imagery are public domain; Chesapeake Conservancy land cover labels have a custom no-warranty disclaimer (not a standard SPDX license); building footprints are ODbL-1.0. ODbL-1.0 is the most restrictive component and governs redistribution.
